# vcp_project (Data Source)

Fetch current project information (balance, currency, etc.).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Information about the current project (balance, currency, state, ...).
data "vcp_project" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `balance` (Number)
- `created` (String)
- `currency` (String)
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `state` (String)
